blocks.x: Clinicians get 90 minutes a day back — ambient documentation inside the EHR

A 12-hospital US health system — a Healthcare & Life Sciences engagement delivered by a blended Dataq Software team under the outcome-linked engagement model. Identity withheld as standard; the figures are the client's, reproduced with permission.
Physicians documented 3+ hours daily; burnout metrics deteriorating across specialties.
Prior AI tools stalled at EHR integration and compliance review. PHI estate faced ransomware exposure from legacy devices and vendor access.

We deployed ambient documentation integrated into the EHR with clinician sign-off, grounded on specialty-specific note templates and governed by the clinical AI board on Compass (model cards, evaluations, oversight gates). A parallel security program segmented medical devices and rehearsed clinical-continuity recovery — including a manual-fallback drill per department.

items: the models and retrieval systems were evaluated before anyone trusted them — grounded answers, cited sources, measured quality.
the data spine was certified once and reused everywhere, which is why the numbers held up under audit.
the controls were architectural — identity-first, segmented, instrumented — not bolted on after the fact.
